output.headerText:
MDBattle-Visualizer (MDBV) - Full Uncompressed Repository Context.
Architecture:
- src/index.js: Entry point (fetch/XHR interception, supplementary HP fetch, DOM/Vue unmount lifecycle)
- src/constants.js: Shared API endpoints, asset URLs, and playback speed constants
- src/state.js: Reactive singleton state store (engineState) and speed/session helpers
- src/participants.js: Participant parsing, summon name inference, and MVP stat aggregation
- src/parser.js: Battle log parser, summon/contract lifecycles, and immutable frame snapshot builder
- src/calibrator.js: Multi-anchor HP calibration and boss rebirth / dynamic HP scaling inference
- src/stage.js: Stage DOM initialization, playback loop, and card animations
- src/timeline.js: Instant time-travel (syncStageToAbsoluteState), ATB bar UI, and combat log DOM
- src/floatingText.js: Floating combat numbers with radial collision avoidance and cumulative combo counters
- src/choreography.js: Combat animation choreography (single-target, AOE wave, cover, clash spark)
- src/combo.js: Combo lookahead, runtime combo state progression, and combo banner UI
- src/cinematics.js: Ultimate cut-ins, contract invocation overlays, and fatality sequences
- src/mvp.js: Post-battle MVP ceremony and damage statistics dashboard
- src/profiles.js: Declarative skill profiles (cinematics, projectile VFX, contract buffs)
- src/spoilerGuard.js: Anti-spoiler DOM masking for the host SPA
- src/styles.js: Scoped CSS stylesheet and keyframe animations
- src/utils.js: HTML escaping, log syntax highlighting, and timing utilities
- scripts/snapshot-runner.mjs: Headless golden snapshot regression test runner
- build.mjs: esbuild Userscript bundler and dist/ai-context.txt generator
